{{Short description|Stream cipher algorithm}}
{{refimprove|date=November 2025}}
In [[cryptography]], '''WG''' is a [[stream cipher|stream cypher]] [[algorithm]] developed by [[Guang Gong]] and [[Yassir Nawaz]]. It has been submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] Project of the [[eCRYPT]] network.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Nawaz |first=Yassir |last2=Gong |first2=Guang |date=2008-04-01 |title=WG: A family of stream ciphers with designed randomness properties |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S002002550700566X |journal=Information Sciences |volume=178 |issue=7 |pages=1903–1916 |doi=10.1016/j.ins.2007.12.002 |issn=0020-0255|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
